source.statement: The paper gives the first quantum Lasso algorithm in O~(r sqrt(mn)/epsilon + poly(n,1/epsilon)) time versus O~(mn^2+n^3) classically; the exact corollary specializes the polynomial term to n^3/epsilon^2.

negative_control: Setting lambda=1 makes both displayed objectives identical and x=1/2 satisfies the stated 1+epsilon guarantee.

firstness_counterexample.objective_mapping: Multiplying the prior objective (1/2)||y-X beta||^2+lambda_prior||beta||_1 by two gives the target family with lambda_target=2 lambda_prior.
firstness_counterexample.second_prior: arXiv:2110.13086, initially published 2021-10-25, also gives a quantum Lasso algorithm.

negative_control: A later matching work and an earlier Ridge-only work are both rejected by the firstness checker.
result: The firstness component is contradicted by two primary pre-target quantum Lasso papers. Independently, the exact printed approximation display has a rational 7/40 impossibility gap.
